{"content": "# Statement of Personal Contributions to the Northwind Go Logging Library

**Prepared for:** Tomás Alvarez's immigration counsel
**Employee:** Tomás Alvarez, Northwind (start date given as 3 March 2025)
**Source:** The repository's git commit history, read on 22 October 2026. The repository is private. No one outside the company can check it unless they are given access.

## What the library is

The repository is the team's Go logging library. It is a copy (a "fork") of the open-source library *logrus*. The history shows it was cloned from `github.com/sirupsen/logrus`, and the module name in `go.mod` is still `github.com/sirupsen/logrus`. Most of the code and history came from the open-source project and its many outside contributors. This statement covers only the commits added on top of that history.

## What the history shows I did, on or after 3 March 2025

Three commits carry my name as author and are dated on or after 3 March 2025.
